q: Which Meta campaigns are wasting money?

checks.what: tool: uses spend plus an outcome metric

answer:
Short answer: these Meta campaigns are spending the most while returning below 1x Net ROAS (losing money on order-date): TH-383-SUSPENDER-29SEP, TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+, TH-222-WINGBIRD-23SEP, TH-149-SCRATCHLOUNGE-6OCT, TH-336-PAWTECH-26SEP, TH-012-SNUGBOO-23SEP and DOG DAD T-SHIRT-CS-06OCT. Together they show high ad spend with ROAS < 1, so they are the best candidates to pause or re-work first.

What changed / why it matters:
- TH-383-SUSPENDER-29SEP — Ad spend ₹24,101 · Net ROAS 0.6x (0.5559). Large spend with ~45%+ loss vs break-even; immediate candidate to cut. 
- TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+ — Ad spend ₹23,526 · Net ROAS 0.5x (0.4802). High spend and the weakest ROAS in the top spenders. 
- TH-222-WINGBIRD-23SEP — Ad spend ₹21,626 · Net ROAS 0.7x (0.6971). Big spend but not recovering COGS + ad costs. 
- TH-149-SCRATCHLOUNGE-6OCT — Ad spend ₹19,817 · Net ROAS 0.9x (0.9248). Close to 1x but still loss-making on order-date P&L. 
- TH-336-PAWTECH-26SEP — Ad spend ₹19,190 · Net ROAS 0.9x (0.8543). Significant spend with below‑break-even returns. 
- TH-012-SNUGBOO-23SEP — Ad spend ₹19,174 · Net ROAS 0.7x (0.7360). Large spend, low efficiency. 
- DOG DAD T-SHIRT-CS-06OCT — Ad spend ₹12,323 · Net ROAS 0.5x (0.4501). Moderate spend, poor returns.

Worth checking: pause or reduce budgets for the campaigns above while you (a) re-evaluate creative/landing pages and (b) drill down by adset and creative to see where performance is concentrated.
